name: Peruvian Amazon
about: Dry season Jun–Sep has the lowest river levels and best wildlife-trail access, especially for macaw clay licks; wet season Dec–Mar means higher rivers and easier canoe access into flooded forest.
overview: Deep Amazon rainforest reached by river or small plane from Puerto Maldonado or Iquitos — some of the best wildlife-watching and birding on Earth.
costOverview: There's no real budget tier here — almost everyone visits via an all-inclusive lodge package, and the price mostly tracks how remote and exclusive the lodge is.
